verdict.rationale: Bitbucket clearly delivers Git repository hosting. The docs mention creating new repositories and repo-level permission management, and community users describe hosting their private repos there. One user praises the commits view, with its rich detail and history graph, while another calls web source browsing slow compared with GitHub's. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of repository creation and management workflows, and first-party evidence of commit-history browsing (only a community report covers it).
